description: Land Acquisition - Thalawakelle, Nuwara Eliya D/S Division, Nuwara Eliya District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters, specifically detailing the government's intention to acquire multiple plots of land with descriptions of each lot, including land names, descriptions, claimants, occupants, and extents. It falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisition, property descriptions, and ownership matters, not government personnel or structural changes.
